features.name: Card Lock After View
features.description: After a player taps to view their identity card and confirms with 'I Remember' button, the card becomes permanently locked. In free mode, any card can be clicked; in sequential mode, only current player's card is clickable.

features.name: Lock State Visual Indicator
features.description: Add visual feedback showing that a card is locked - greyed out appearance with checkmark overlay, lock icon, and disabled interaction state. Clearly distinguish viewed vs unviewed cards.

features.name: Sequential Mode Toggle
features.description: Add a mode selector in game settings: 'Free Mode' (current behavior - all cards clickable) vs 'Sequential Mode' (only current player's card is enabled, others disabled until previous confirms). Sequential mode prevents any possibility of peeking.

features.name: AI Image Generation Integration
features.description: Integrate Gemini image generation API to create funny/quirky images for each word pair. Images should hint at the word while being humorous and slightly abstract. Use gemini-image skill.

features.name: Image Style Selector
features.description: Add a 'quirkiness level' slider in settings (Low/Medium/High or 1-5 scale) that controls how abstract/funny the generated images are. Higher = more distorted/humorous, Lower = more recognizable.

features.name: Card Image Display
features.description: Update PlayerCard component to display the generated image alongside the word. Image should be prominent but word remains the primary identifier. Show image on the revealed side of the card.

features.name: Image Loading States
features.description: Add skeleton/loading states while images are being generated. Handle error states gracefully with fallback to text-only mode. Show progress indicator during generation.

features.name: Image Caching System
features.description: Implement caching for generated images to avoid repeated API calls for the same word pairs. Store in localStorage or IndexedDB for offline availability and faster subsequent games.

features.name: Pre-generate Image Option
features.description: Option for host to pre-generate images before starting the game to ensure smooth gameplay without loading delays during card reveals. Show generation progress.

features.name: Backend Infrastructure Setup
features.description: Set up Supabase project for real-time room management. Configure Realtime subscriptions, create rooms table with room_code, host_id, settings, players, and game_state columns.

features.name: Room Creation System
features.description: Create room/lobby UI where host enters nickname, configures game settings, and generates a unique 4-6 character room code. Store room in Supabase with realtime subscription.

features.name: QR Code Generation
features.description: Generate QR code for room sharing using qrcode.react library. Display in invite modal alongside room code and copy link button. QR encodes the join URL.

features.name: Room Join Flow
features.description: Allow players to join a room via link (URL with room code) or by entering room code manually. Player enters nickname, gets assigned slot, sees realtime player list updates.

features.name: Identity Card Distribution
features.description: When host starts the game, randomly assign roles (civilian/imposter) and words, then distribute to each connected player via Supabase realtime. Each player sees only their own card on their device.
